# Luca Caruso – Digital Evangelism

> Luca Caruso is a digital evangelist and media missionary from Italy. He equips young people and Christian creators to share the Gospel on social media, and builds pathways that connect online encounters with Jesus to real discipleship in local churches.

Key facts:

- Has worked in missions and media for over 10 years, looking for new ways to share the Gospel.
- Joined his first mission trip at 16, sharing the Gospel on the streets of Italy.
- After film school, became Media Director for Jesus Revolution, travelling the world and helping young people share their faith online.
- In 2026 he was selected for Catalyze Lab, a six-month global accelerator for initiatives bringing the Gospel to the next generation, run by OneHope and Missional Labs. He was one of 11 selected from 76 applicants, and the only one from Europe.
- Runs "Jesus Goes Viral" activations at youth events: young people learn to share their faith online, then create and publish short videos about Jesus on their own profiles, many for the first time.
- At Yous Conference 2026 in Italy (October 31st, 850 young people from over 80 churches), 646 young people took part. In one hour they created 316 pieces of content, which reached over 652,000 views in the first 17 hours.
- His vision: a generation of Christian creators rather than passive consumers, and digital outreach that leads people into local churches.

Topics he can speak to: digital evangelism, how to share the Gospel online, preaching the Gospel on social media, Christian content creators sharing Jesus, activating youth groups in digital outreach, new ways of sharing the Gospel, and connecting online evangelism to local church discipleship.
